Each il07-adapter-il0N.l4 (and il07-adapter-il08-ito.l4, il07-adapter-il08-nii.l4) imports this row's nouns and one row only. See RECONCILE.md section 1. Version 0.3.0 re-recorded 31 lines after the row repairs of 2026-10-08 (29 changed modules, and the two IL-04 pins left on commit 60c7637, on no branch after the lead's rebase, now on 374b220); every line names a commit on main. NOTES.md section 12.2. Version 0.4.0 re-recorded 15 lines after the rulings of 2026-10-08 (NOTES.md section 13.2). Version 0.5.0 re-recorded 24 lines after rows IL-46 to IL-53 (SHRUG); every other line held. scope: Answered: months of 2026, for a household with one employed parent paid the same salary every month of 2026, possibly a spouse with no income, and the parent's own children. Composed: the s 121 tax and the s 121B additional tax (IL-03) on the year's income (under ITO s 65, IL-08, where the couple is assessed together in the earner's name), less the credit points of ss 34, 36, 36A (IL-01), s 35 (IL-08), s 66(c) in a separate calculation with s 37's point halved (IL-02, IL-08), ss 37-39 under s 65 (IL-08), s 40(b) for a parent without a spouse (IL-08), at the 2026 credit-point value from s 120B(e)(1) (IL-03) and the Tax Authority's 2025 figure (IL-01), and the s 45A credit (IL-08); one twelfth of it (fork K1); the employer's deduction under NII s 342(c) (IL-05) of Schedule J column D (IL-04), read at its printed totals by Meng's ruling of 2026-10-07, through row IL-04's own switch from 0.2.1 (the items' reading kept as fork K14; K18) on the s 348 income (IL-05) in the branches s 335 gives (IL-08), with a woman's Schedule A1 Part D age (IL-08); the child allowance under NII ss 65-68 (IL-06) for the children s 72 pays for in the month (IL-08), with the s 66 additional-tax exclusion joined to IL-03's s 121B (fork K5). Inputs, not encoded: the health insurance contribution (National Health Insurance Law), the registered spouse (ITO s 64B is encoded by IL-08 but reads facts the household does not hold), residence and insurance statuses, and, in the further facts of version 0.2.0, the pension contributions and insurance premiums, immigration, the statuses ss 37 and 335 read, and the single-parent facts. Declined by name: every month outside 2026; a spouse with income; a couple assessed under ITO s 65 in the other spouse's name; a parent without a spouse whose single-parent facts are not given; an earner with a credit or deduction no row encodes (ss 39A-40D, 44-46 and the like); a salary that varies across the year (ITO s 164 and its Regulations); (0.2.x: a month for which s 72 pays children row IL-06 counts together on no day, an 18th birthday on the 1st; answered from 0.3.0); an earner whose immigration falls in the period of the Encouragement of Aliyah and Return (Temporary Provision) Law 5786-2026, 5 November 2025 to the end of 2026 (from 0.3.0); a deduction on a salary below the full adult minimum wage for an earner to whom it does not apply (from 0.3.0 only below it); where s 47 would deduct anything; the deduction of an earner who does not pay in all six deduction branches, at the printed totals (from 0.4.0 only a set whose rate the Institute does not publish, a non-resident among them: row IL-04's fork F21); March of the 18th year of a child born on 29 February (from 0.4.0, fork K22); where the order of the s 47 deduction and the s 45A credit changes the answer (row IL-08's fork F35, declined by it from 0.4.0) (0.2.x also declined its defects D187, D183, D055 and observation 1, repaired by the row on 2026-10-08); the rows' own refusals. GAPS.md has the status of every gap. (0.6.0: the Encouragement of Aliyah and Return (Temporary Provision) Law 5786-2026 composed for a first immigration under the Law of Return from 5 November 2025 to 1 January 2026 (row IL-36); Schedule K's minimum from the Minimum Wage Law (row IL-32); ITO ss 48 and 48A where the caller adds the facts (row IL-28); beside the pipeline, the tax withheld under the 5753-1993 Regulations (row IL-26) and a cross-check of the health contribution (row IL-25). NOTES.md section 15.)

forks.K1: The year's tax against a month: one twelfth of the year's tax for a salary the same every month (reported as a share, not as tax withheld); declined otherwise, because withholding is ITO s 164 and Regulations not in the sources. (0.5.0: SHRUG class (c), the month's figure a named share of the year's tax, and (d) for withholding, whose Regulations are not in the sources; NOTES.md section 14.5) (0.6.0: unchanged as the answer; reading (ii), the tax withheld under the 5753-1993 Regulations, is offered beside it by name from row IL-26; NOTES.md section 15.6)
forks.K2: The 2026 credit-point value: IL-03's s 120B(e)(1) from the 1 January 2024 rounded figure, which is the Tax Authority's published 2025 value (2,904, IL-01); twelve times the booklet's monthly 242 agrees.
forks.K3: Credits are set off against the s 121 tax only, never below nil, and the s 121B additional tax is added after; where the credits exceed the s 121 tax and there is additional tax, declined. (0.5.0: SHRUG class (b), already declined where the readings part)
forks.K4: The earner's taxable income is the year's salary in every case answered; a spouse with income is declined. (0.2.0) A couple with no separate calculation is assessed under ITO s 65 (row IL-08): answered where the earner is the registered spouse, declined where the other spouse is. (0.5.0: SHRUG class (b), the spouse has no income, so no reading moves any; the registered spouse's request under (c)(1A) is row IL-02's switch F18, passed on and nameable)
forks.K5: IL-06's 'income chargeable to additional tax' is read for the tax year in which the month falls: TRUE iff IL-03's s 121B tax for that year is above nil. (0.4.0) With further facts, on the taxable income after the s 47 deduction; the deduction asked only where the salary itself bears additional tax. (0.6.0: on the income after row IL-36's exemption where the capstone composes it)
forks.K6: SUPERSEDED in 0.2.0 by K15. (0.1.0: IL-06 is asked about the first day of the month; a month in which a child is born or turns 18 after that day is declined (NII s 72).)
forks.K7: s 36A's half point is counted once, from IL-01, though IL-02 restates it in s 66(c)(4). (0.3.0: IL-02's half point now declines a foreign-worker woman too, its 02-R2; still counted once, from IL-01.)
